candidate_selection: One grid fit chosen by declared training objective; no held-out loss used.
continuous_zero_atom: 1498 exact-zero dwells exist. All three continuous optimizations converge to the same finite interior fit; the continuous density is a misspecified reference, not a zero-atom generative model.
grid_observation_likelihood: For y between a=60*floor(y/60) and b=a+60, maximize (1-f)*log p(a|d)+f*log p(b|d), f=(y-a)/60. p(k|d) is the row-normalized Gaussian potential on k=0,60,120,... . This is expected randomized-coarsening log likelihood.
integration: Upper integration limit includes observed maximum and extends 12 sigma beyond the Gaussian location. Only location and scale are fitted; no held-out tuning.
deployment_limit: Not exact adaptive-grid HMM maximum likelihood: finite delay boundaries, known absolute anchors and full chain conditioning change transition rows. Cold 60-second lattice cannot match the observed zero-dwell mean and variance simultaneously.
fine_grid_recipe: Largest divisor of 60 no greater than observed zero-dwell mean+variance/mean: 20 seconds; central delay [-300,300] seconds, original minute tails and exact observation anchors retained. This necessary variance condition is not a guarantee of model fit.

baseline_training.units: Route delay and running/dwell residual increments in minutes.
baseline_training.forecast_sd_rule: Route training departure spread times 60 seconds, with 30-second floor. This bandwidth is not fitted to held-out forecast errors.

candidate_training.units: Route delay and running/dwell residual increments in minutes.
candidate_training.forecast_sd_rule: Route training departure spread times 60 seconds, with 30-second floor. This bandwidth is not fitted to held-out forecast errors.
candidate_training.increment_source: July25 only, expected categorical log likelihood after mean-preserving randomized coarsening onto nonnegative 60-second duration grid.

continuous_training.units: Route delay and running/dwell residual increments in minutes.
continuous_training.forecast_sd_rule: Route training departure spread times 60 seconds, with 30-second floor. This bandwidth is not fitted to held-out forecast errors.
continuous_training.increment_source: July25 only continuous nonnegative truncated-normal likelihood. Deployed only with the experiment CDF-cell duration kernel and fixed 20-second central grid.
